# Electrician Jobs in Coimbatore

> Electricians are wanted in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Pay is ₹800 to ₹1,200 per day, based on skills and experience. Regular long-term work, or temporary work for 1 day, 1 week or 1 month. Own bike is mandatory. Coimbatore local candidates get first preference. Apply by calling or messaging on WhatsApp: +91 890 301 302 6.

Last updated: 12 November 2026

## Job facts
- Job title: Electrician
- Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- Pay: ₹800 – ₹1,200 per day, based on skills and experience
- Work: house wiring, switchboard work, electrical installation and maintenance
- Work options: regular long-term job, or temporary work for 1 day, 1 week or 1 month
- Advantage: CCTV and networking knowledge
- Must have: basic practical electrician knowledge, own bike
- Preference: Coimbatore local candidates
- Documents: Aadhaar card or other valid ID proof, address proof, experience details if available
- ID proof verification is mandatory
- Contact: +91 890 301 302 6 (call or WhatsApp)

## Tamil summary
